items.name: DisplayPos
items.summary: The line and column of an offset in a source file.

items.name: DisplayRange
items.summary: A range in a file, with a start and end, both containing line and column. Stored in terms of characters, not including any BOM.

methods.name: serialize
methods.signature: fn serialize<S>(&self, serializer: S) -> Result<S::Ok, S::Error> where S: serde::Serializer

items.name: LineNumber
items.summary: A line number in a file.

methods.name: clamp_position
methods.summary: Clamp a byte offset so it is safe to pass to `LineIndex::source_location`. Handles offsets past EOF (#1698) and offsets inside multi-byte UTF-8 characters (#3041).

methods.name: content_in_line_range
methods.signature: fn content_in_line_range(&self, start_line: LineNumber, end_line: LineNumber) -> &str
methods.summary: Gets the content from the beginning of start_line to the end of end_line.

methods.name: display_pos
methods.signature: fn display_pos(&self, offset: TextSize, notebook: Option<&Notebook>) -> DisplayPos

methods.name: display_range
methods.signature: fn display_range(&self, range: TextRange, notebook: Option<&Notebook>) -> DisplayRange

methods.name: from_display_pos
methods.summary: Convert from a user position to a `TextSize`. Doesn't take account of a leading BOM, so should be used carefully.

methods.name: from_display_range
methods.summary: Convert from a user range to a `TextRange`. Doesn't take account of a leading BOM, so should be used carefully.

methods.name: from_lsp_position
methods.signature: fn from_lsp_position(&self, position: lsp_types::Position, notebook_and_cell: Option<(&Notebook, usize)>) -> TextSize
methods.summary: Translates an LSP position to a text size. For notebooks, the input position is relative to a notebook cell and the output position is relative to the concatenated contents of the notebook.

methods.name: from_lsp_range
methods.signature: fn from_lsp_range(&self, position: lsp_types::Range, notebook_and_cell: Option<(&Notebook, usize)>) -> TextRange
methods.summary: Translates an LSP position to a text range. For notebooks, the input range is relative to a notebook cell and the output position is range to the concatenated contents of the notebook.

methods.name: python_ast_range_for_expr
methods.signature: fn python_ast_range_for_expr(&self, original_range: TextRange, expr: &Expr, parent_expr: Option<&Expr>) -> PythonASTRange
methods.summary: Convert an expression's range into a `PythonASTRange`.

methods.name: to_cell_for_lsp
methods.signature: fn to_cell_for_lsp(&self, x: TextSize, notebook: Option<&Notebook>) -> Option<usize>
methods.summary: If the module is a notebook, take an input position relative to the concatenated contents and return the index of the corresponding notebook cell.

methods.name: to_lsp_position
methods.signature: fn to_lsp_position(&self, x: TextSize, notebook: Option<&Notebook>) -> lsp_types::Position
methods.summary: Translates a text size to a LSP position. For notebook, the input position is relative to the concatenated contents of the whole notebook and the output position is relative to a specific cell.

methods.name: to_lsp_range
methods.signature: fn to_lsp_range(&self, x: TextRange, notebook: Option<&Notebook>) -> lsp_types::Range
methods.summary: Translates a text range to a LSP range. For notebook, the input range is relative to the concatenated contents of the whole notebook and the output range is relative to a specific cell.

items.name: PythonASTRange
items.summary: Source location in Python AST conventions: 1-indexed lines, 0-indexed columns.

methods.signature: fn serialize<S>(&self, serializer: S) -> Result<S::Ok, S::Error> where S: serde::Serializer
